caption: The drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil on off-white or cream-colored paper and consists of two main views of an object that resembles a small, ornate box or case. The upper object is drawn in a perspective view, showing a rectangular, slightly convex box with rounded corners and edges. The top of the box features a detailed relief carving of two human figures in an embrace, with intricately defined clothing and limbs. Below this perspective view, there is a side elevation of the same box, presenting a profile of its lid and body, illustrated with fine, parallel lines to suggest depth and contour. The objects are centered within a larger rectangular border on the paper. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner with the name "Clayton Braun." There is no color other than the shading created by the graphite pencil.
title: Silver Snuff Box
